market_question: Will Silver (SI) hit (HIGH) $120 by end of June?
reasoning: Silver reaching $120 by June 2026 would require a >300% surge from current ~$30 levels, shattering the all-time high near $50. Even with hyperinflation or extreme supply shocks, such a move in under 15 months is historically unprecedented and economically unsound. The market's 6.6% implied probability is orders of magnitude too high, making No a strong value bet.
evidence_points: Silver's all-time high is ~$50 (2011), so $120 represents a 140% increase beyond that peak.
Current spot price is ~$30, requiring a 4x rally with no apparent fundamental catalyst.
Even during the 2000s commodity supercycle, silver took years to rally from ~$5 to $50; $120 in <15 months is implausible.
sources_consulted: CME Silver futures contract specifications and active month definitions
General knowledge of commodity market dynamics and inflation scenarios
